The '''Alderaan Department of the Arts''' was a government institution of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The Department of Arts had its office in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]], which could be accessed by the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|First Hall]]. It contained four desks and several [[holoposter]]s depicting Alderaanian art displays. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but a sizeable portion of the Palace survived the cataclysm and was preserved with the mass of [[Asteroid 7785]]. The office of the Department of Arts was part of those miraculously preserved ruins.
